All destroyed states persist: broken knees, severed arms, opened chest armor, shattered necks, exploded capacitors, fallen fragments, smoke, and molten edges never restore.

[Shot 1] A moves on frame one. In a ground-hugging low-angle push-in, her boot slams into broken stone, blasting gravel, rain-mud dust, and sparks outward. A zenith lightning bolt strikes into her raised right hand and compresses instantly into a giant blue-white thunder blade longer than her arm. Her pupils lock on B before the head turns; brow tightens slightly, lips pull into a cold line. She bursts half a step toward front-left and spins into a brutal horizontal slash. The thunder blade skims the ground in a semicircular arc, slicing B’s knee joints, then reverses upward into B’s chest core. B’s knees explode apart, the body collapses into a ruined kneel, and the chest bursts outward. Metal fragments spray in a fan; black smoke tears upward. As A rises and stops hard, armor, torso, cape, and curly hair all show one brief real inertia response. B remains kneeling, chest blown open.

[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, a whip-pan flash-shake snaps the view toward frame-right. C swings a heavy fist. The camera side-tracks as A rotates her hips and slips past the punch wind. Her eyes flash dangerous contempt and one mouth corner compresses into a short cold smirk. The thunder blade softens into a giant lightning whip, sliding along the cape’s metal edge, then lashing out from her waist side. It wraps around C’s mechanical arm and shoulder joint. A yanks with both hands; the whip tightens, tearing the arm away. The severed arm flies off with a blue-white electric tail, hits the ground, and bounces once. The same current drills into C’s chest cavity and crushes the core inward. C falls with a severed arm and collapsed chest, locked in that state.

[Shot 3] At 00:05.000, a rapid push-pull impact shot rushes into A’s palm and snaps back to a half-body frame. The lightning whip recoils into a violent electric core, then straightens into a thunder spear. A never poses; feet keep adjusting, shoulders drop, breath shortens, and chest armor shows a brief breath-and-braking response. Her gaze cuts from C’s wreckage toward D, pupils moving first; jaw tightens and the expression cools into precise targeting.

[Shot 4] At 00:06.000, FPV high-speed traversal begins from A’s palm along the thunder spear. The camera rides the spear through smoke, sparks, airborne fragments, and rain mist toward D’s head-neck joint. The spear is a high-speed plasma lance, not a beam. On impact, the white core flashes; D’s neck, shoulder armor, and sensors burst together. D sinks into a half-kneel, black smoke coughing from the rear. As the spear grazes fragments, secondary branching arcs leap through them, reinforcing the conductive path. D remains half-kneeling, neck shattered and disabled.

[Shot 5] At 00:08.000, the camera rises from a low angle into a brief overhead cut. A grabs the returning spear with both hands; it folds into a giant thunder hammer. The low angle sees her short-jump inside the same encirclement, never leaving center. The camera follows the hammer into a short overhead cut as it smashes E’s back capacitor and spine armor. A ground-hugging shockwave erupts, dust expands in a circular ring, stones rise then fall, and E’s back armor detonates segment by segment. The body arches backward and breaks apart with black smoke columns and orange-gold sparks. A lands; the impact and breath create another brief armor-supported body response while hair and cape settle late.

From her palm, four extremely thin high-brightness arcs shoot into the damaged cores of B, C, D, and E like simultaneous execution lines. B’s chest core dies, C’s collapsed chest flashes blue once, D’s broken neck sparks briefly, and E’s back capacitor burns fully black. A’s eyes scan the wreckage with one instant of controlled satisfaction, then the look is suppressed back into alertness.

[Shot 7] At 00:12.200, the camera pulls back fast, rises slightly into a shallow overhead angle, and makes a small arc around the same encirclement. All four ruined robots are clearly visible in their locked positions: B kneeling with chest blown open, C fallen with severed arm and crushed chest, D half-kneeling with broken head-neck assembly, E smoking with exploded back armor. A stands in the center. She closes her right hand, forcibly drawing the four residual arcs back into her palm like weapons returning to a sheath. Her cape slowly falls; curly hair remains faintly lifted by the residual electric field. Her gaze moves across all four wrecks, then passes beyond the frame toward a distant unseen threat. Brow presses down again; expression shifts from post-kill sharpness into deeper vigilance.
